providers.name: Doria — National Library of Finland map collections
providers.rights: Per-item rights: Public Domain Mark, CC0, or an explicit “Public domain” statement. The verbatim Doria/MODS statements are retained on every record; restrictive or conflicting statements are withheld.
providers.method: Doria (National Library of Finland) OAI-PMH Maps set com_10024_109232, combining oai_dc discovery, MODS date/rights and ORE bitstreams; rights-gated and published as a catalogue shard.

metadataReuse.decision: Bundled records withheld from the shipped reusable catalogue in commit for 2026-10-20 because no primary metadata-reuse licence or other substantiated redistribution basis was established for this scope. Image rights are not the question here and are unchanged; full records are retained under research/withheld/ with their original rights evidence.
metadataReuse.evidence: The public OAI-PMH endpoint is reachable and documented by Doria (ListSets/ListRecords). The terms page https://www.doria.fi/page/terms answers HTTP 200 but its static page body is empty at retrieval (2026-10-20); https://www.doria.fi/page/about is an unfilled template. No repository-wide metadata licence or bulk-redistribution grant was found.

providers.name: Leventhal Map & Education Center — Boston Public Library
providers.operator: Boston Public Library, Norman B. Leventhal Map & Education Center
providers.rights: The verbatim rights and licence statement is retained on every record. Bundled records carry an affirmative no-known-copyright-restrictions / no-restrictions-on-use determination, NoC-US, CC0 or CC BY. Items without such a determination are not imported.
providers.attribution: Norman B. Leventhal Map & Education Center, Boston Public Library
providers.method: Documented Blacklight JSON search (genre Maps, per_page 100, 153 pages) over every Boston Public Library-held cartographic record, with per-record rights evidence; no decade, geography, collection or record-count cap.

rightsPolicy.metadataReuse: The documented JSON search and item endpoints are publicly readable; Digital Commonwealth does not publish a separate metadata licence. Metadata is therefore cited to the catalogue and per-item rights statements are retained verbatim rather than relabelled. Images are reused only where the item itself carries an affirmative determination.

imageRightsBasis.no-known-restrictions: rights_ss "No known copyright restrictions." + license_ss "No known restrictions on use." + reuse_allowed_ssi "no restrictions" as stated by the holding institution; retained verbatim, not labelled public domain or CC0.
imageRightsBasis.cc-by: license_ss explicitly names a Creative Commons Attribution licence; the versioned licence URI (license_uri_ss or the IIIF manifest license) and the stated credit are retained.
imageRightsBasis.no-copyright-us: rights_ss states NoC-US; the rightsstatements.org URI is retained when supplied.
imageRightsBasis.public-domain: rights_ss explicitly names the public domain with no restrictions on use.
